summary: 8–13 week summer programme at CERN with lectures and a research or technical project (physics, engineering, computing, maths).
eligibility: Bachelor's or Master's students with about 6 semesters done; all nationalities welcome. Not for PhD students or past participants.
title: CERN Summer Student Programme 2027

prize.description: CHF 94 per calendar day (about ₹11,000) plus a travel lump sum.

notes: Applications open November 2026 and close in late January 2027 (26 Jan in the last cycle); no late submissions.
